cohort: Infants born between 34(+0) and 41(+6) weeks at Hadassah Medical Centers in 2023.
finding: Early-term (ET) infants experienced increased short-term morbidity compared to full-term (FT) neonates, though they were more stable than late-preterm (LP) infants.
mod_finding: Early-term infants exhibited more frequent elective cesarean deliveries compared to full-term infants.
